name: Farm register
uses: your farms: add, edit, delete; saved to Firestore when the page has a Firebase project, otherwise in this browser

name: Farm weather and water balance
uses: Open-Meteo forecast and archive (rain, FAO-56 reference ET0) at each registered farm, live, no key

name: Crop water need calculator
uses: FAO-56 crop coefficients (Table 12) x Open-Meteo 7-day ET0 and rain forecast

name: Topsoil at a location
uses: ISRIC SoilGrids 250 m (pH, carbon, nitrogen, texture, CEC, bulk density), live

name: Country farm indicators
uses: World Bank Open Data (FAO, ILO sources), latest reported year, live
